value.rationale: The one-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the nonsmooth boundary is an intrinsic geometric regularity invariant. The result completely optimizes it over the 3-way independent surgery choices for arbitrary fixed Reuleaux polyhedra, with a strict preference ordering valid regardless of chord asymmetry, and derives the natural sharp small-opposite-chord limit. Unlike a standalone ellipse-perimeter computation, it settles global mixed-family maximizers/minimizers and quantifies a genuine geometry trade-off.
